summary: Baileys fork pulls libsignal dependency from an unpinned GitHub branch
details: package.json declares `libsignal` as `github:chatunitycenter/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. On `npm install`, npm clones the default-branch HEAD of that repository and installs whatever it returns, including executing any lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) present in the cloned source. The resolved bytes are mutable: whoever controls the `chatunitycenter/libsignal-node` repository can push new commits at any time and those commits will run on every installer that resolves this dependency going forward. The dependency key resembles the well-known `libsignal-node` project but points to an account-controlled fork rather than a registry version range or a pinned commit, so the installer cannot audit or reproduce what will be fetched.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
